lines.text: Mordecai tears his clothes, puts on sackcloth and ashes, and goes only as far as the king's gate.
Where the king's decree reaches, Jews fast and weep, and Mordecai refuses the clothes Esther sends him.
Hathach learns from Mordecai how much money Haman promised and receives a letter from Haman.

wrong_details.true: a copy of the written decree

lines.text: Anyone approaching the king uninvited in the inner court dies unless he extends the scepter; Esther went forty days unsummoned.
Esther tells Mordecai to gather the Jews in Susa and fast three days, then she will go to the king.
